text: By order of the Coastal Authority, the light at Relay Nine is to be extinguished at dawn. There is no longer a coast to guard.
speaker: LETTER

text: There is a coast. You are standing on it. It just has no sea.
speaker: TIDE

text: Three hundred and twelve facets of pressed glass. Each one holds a smaller lamp, turning.
speaker: LENS

text: Then nobody has done that since today. I will boil. It takes a while. Most things worth doing do.
speaker: KETTLE

text: ...this is the Marigold, out of nowhere... we have been at sea since the sea left... we navigate by you...
speaker: STATIC

text: "Dear Keeper, I can see your light from my bedroom. When it comes round I say goodnight to it. Does it say goodnight back. From Ilse, age 7."
speaker: TIDE

text: When the beam crosses the town, the shape lifts a hand.
speaker: LENS

text: Dawn at 06:12. Fourteen minutes. The switch is on the wall, where it has always been, under a little brass cover.
speaker: LEDGER

text: Whatever you do, do it on purpose.
speaker: TIDE
